title: 知識情報処理
subtitle: Intelligent Information Processing
teachers:
KINDO Toshiki
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Intelligent information processing requires knowledge to be represented and stored systematically. Students will:
(1)	Learn how to represent and use knowledge for problem solving and transform knowledge into a data structure for knowledge representation in computers.
(2)	Touch briefly on AI programming and deepen their understanding of problem solving, machine learning, natural language processing, etc.
advice:
This course is a lecture/practice course that gives an overview of artificial intelligence, which has recently been in the spotlight again. First, students will learn an outline of intelligent information processing. Next, students learn about search algorithms used in computer shogi programs, localization techniques important for robot cars (automated driving vehicles), and machine learning for big data processing. Finally, students learn about natural language processing, image processing, etc. To deepen their understanding of each method, emphasis is placed on tackling the quizzes that are presented throughout the semester.

We will cover the following materials:

1. Basics of intelligent information processing.
2. Problem solving (state space model, various search algorithms, and dynamic programming).
3. Probabilistic methods (Bayesian theory, reinforcement learning, and localization).
4. Machine learning (clustering and pattern recognition).
5. Natural language processing.
books:
Textbooks：An Illusrated Guide to Artificial Intelligence
Reference books：None
Reserved books：None
requiredKnowledge: “Problem solving” requires basic algorithms, “inference” requires probability theory at a high school level, and “machine learning” requires understanding of linear algebra. Additionally, the quizzes include tasks that students are encouraged to solve in their favorite programming language because they take a considerable amount of time if done manually.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand and explain the basic concepts of intelligent information processing.
Be able to understand and explain search algorithms and dynamic programming for problem solving.
Be able to understand and explain localization methods.
Be able to understand and explain how to apply machine learning to those problem and solve them.
Be able to understand and explain the basics of natural language processing and image processing.
